newsitem.title: FINLAND: NESTE TANKER IN CRASH, SMALL DAMAGE SEEN.
newsitem.headline: NESTE TANKER IN CRASH, SMALL DAMAGE SEEN.

text.p: Finnish state-controlled energy group Neste Oy said on Monday its Natura oil tanker had collided with a German submarine in the Baltic Sea, but no one was injured and the damage amounted to a few million markka at most.
"The damage is likely to cost a few hundred thousand markka or a few million at the maximum," Neste executive vice president Erkki Gronqvist told Reuters by telephone.

Natura had been able to continue its journey immediately after the collision, and it was due to arrive on Wednesday at the port of Naantali in south-western Finland where the damages will be checked, he said.
Gronqvist said Neste had found no evidence of any spillage.
